title: Main Hoon Hero No 1
desc: A young man attempts to fight against a fraudster, who tries to cheat him, while trying to maintain his married life, which is being disturbed by his crude mother-in-law.

title: Saas Bina Chain Kaha Re
desc: Chaos ensues as two mothers-in-law and two daughters-in-law share the same living space. They attempt to navigate their daily lives but end up getting into unnecessary arguments.

title: Dulhan Wahi Jo Piya Man Bhaye
desc: Raja falls in love with Diya in London and returns home to seek his father's approval. However, in a tragic twist, his dying father asks him to marry Tulsi.

title: Rishton Ka Batwara
desc: Members in a family argue over property claims and take each other to court. However, this dispute drives a wedge in their relationships which affects future generations.
